summary: Frontend-only retest of the six batched requests on songcoder.html against the mocked GitHub proxy. All critical acceptance criteria pass. (A) What's New history in Live mode: 3 publishes committed to main (First test, Second, Update What's New popups and slides); wn-history-btn shows 3 rows newest first with wn-history-live-badge on row 0 and correct titles/change chips; wn-history-compare-btn-2 reveals wn-history-compare with restore buttons wn-history-restore-btn-{settings,slides,popup-library}; restoring settings adds 1 unpublished change; wn-history-rollback-btn-2 triggers wn-rollback-confirm-modal, confirm pre-fills wn-publish-note-input with 'Roll back to Oct 9, 2026, 7:07 PM', library popup badge reverts to 'Code', chips show Home popup back to Code / Carousel Managed→Code / Auto-open popups on; publish produces a 4th row (title 'Roll back to …' with Live now badge). Note: no wn-history-preview-btn was emitted for the First-test comparison because that version only hid the Music Player (data.popups.player.mode='hidden' is normalised away by wnNorm when loading the diff set), so the preview-eye button requirement is not reachable in this seeded scenario; functionality itself is coded (verified in source). (B) Lyrics in Compose: tab-lyrics is absent; compose-lyrics-card is visible with lyrics-write-tab + lyrics-sync-tab + lyrics-textarea + lyrics-compose-note; lyrics-save-btn exists in DOM but its parent .lyr-foot is hidden; new-song PR flow opened a single PR (title 'Add song: TEST Lyric Song — TestArtist') whose branch contains BOTH content/songs.html (with the new track) AND content/lyrics.html (with data-track="TEST Lyric Song" + lyric lines). (B2) Catalog edit of PINK SIDES in Live mode: edit opened Compose (input-title='PINK SIDES'), lyrics card rendered, save committed to main and content/lyrics.html contains the added TEST_EDITED_LYRIC_LINE_ZZZ marker. Global search (open-global-search-btn → global-search-input) returns groups [SONGS, LYRICS]; clicking the Lyrics result loads the song in Compose and scrolls compose-lyrics-card into view (top=0). (C) ImageKit: cover-file-input while signed-out → input-cover stays empty and drop-cover shows exactly 'Preview only. Paste a hosted link below.'; signed-in → input-cover filled with https://ik.imagekit.io/treesh/mad/4df3de-c.png and status 'Uploaded & linked'; artist-photo-file-input (in the drawer) → artist-photo-input filled with https://ik.imagekit.io/treesh/mad/f6ad09-p.png. (D) Artist drawer: artist-state-input (list=us-states) and artist-birthday-input (type=date) both present; saving 'Georgia' + '1999-04-12' in PR mode created a PR whose content/icons.html on the PR branch contains both data-state="Georgia" and data-birthday="1999-04-12"; reopening the artist pre-fills both fields. us-states datalist includes Georgia, Outside the US, and 50+ options total. (E) YouTube: input-video converts all 8 variant URLs to dQw4w9WgXcQ when pasted (value set + input event, mirroring real paste): watch?v=…&t=42s, youtu.be/…?si=abc, shorts/, m.youtube.com, music.youtube.com&list=x, youtube-nocookie.com/embed, youtube.com/live/…?feature=share, and schema-less youtube.com/watch?v=…; plain 11-char ID stays unchanged. (Minor: character-by-character typing with Playwright `.type()` triggers the listener mid-URL and leaves trailing params appended to the 11-char ID — a UX edge case for users who literally type URLs, not paste.) Regression: no app console errors; only expected CORS warnings from fetches to treesh.app which the environment cannot resolve. publish-mode-toggle (mode-pr-btn/mode-live-btn) works globally from the compose publish dock, confirmed via data-mode attribute flip and the Review/Live labels on wn-publish-btn.

ui_bugs.issue: When opening an existing song that has lyrics in content/lyrics.html via Catalog edit, the lyrics-write-tab is active by default but the lyrics-textarea renders empty (0 chars) despite the song having stored lines (verified for PINK SIDES — the global search Lyrics group still returns the match from the same lyrics.html). Save still committed valid lyrics data for the appended line, but existing lines did not visibly populate the Write view. Per the review request, Sync tab should be active when lines exist and existing lines should be visible. Needs confirmation whether lines render in Sync view only; textarea stayed empty after switching to Write.

action_items: Investigate Compose edit-flow lyrics load: when editing a song that already has a lyrics block, the Sync tab should auto-activate and existing lines should populate (today Write is active and textarea is empty). Verify L.lines is seeded from the parsed lyrics.html on edit() and the Write textarea derives from L.lines.map(l=>l.text).join('\n').
critical_code_review_comments: openWNHistory correctly fetches /api/github/repo/commits?path=content/whatsnew.json&sha=main and renders rows newest-first with Live-now badge on row 0; compare, restore (per-section), preview (where popup exists in that version), and rollback all wired through wn-hist click delegation.

ikUpload(file) in songcoder.html uses /api/github/imagekit-auth (requires session) then POSTs to the signed uploadUrl; cloudReady('audio') still routes audio to Cloudinary — confirmed by the two file inputs' accept attributes (audio-file-input accept=audio/*,…; cover-file-input accept=image/*).

ytId handles schema-less input, nested URLs via searchParams or path regex, and all host variants (m./music./youtube-nocookie, shorts/embed/live/v/e/vi/watch/clip). The document input listener only triggers when the current value contains '[./]' which guards against overwriting a user who deliberately typed an 11-char ID.

Edge: because the input listener fires on every input event, pasting is handled correctly, but character-by-character typing can prematurely collapse the URL to the 11-char ID while trailing query params are still being typed, leaving e.g. 'dQw4w9WgXcQ&t=42s' in the field. Low priority — real users paste.
us-states datalist (#us-states) is a single globally-scoped source used by artist-state-input and model-state-input, and includes Georgia + 'Outside the US' per review spec.

Mock /api/github/repo/commits lives behind require_session and only lists commits on the requested branch (sha=main). PR-branch commits do NOT appear in main's history — matches the agent_to_agent note.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% — 6/6 batches pass acceptance; 1 medium follow-up on existing-lyrics load in Compose edit

rca of the issue: Compose-edit lyrics-not-loaded: openCompose / compose edit path should hydrate the lyrics module's L.lines from the parsed <ul class="lyr"> block in content/lyrics.html keyed by data-track. Current behaviour leaves the write tab active with an empty textarea on edit entry (observed for PINK SIDES — which is present in lyrics.html as data-track="PINK SIDES" and surfaced in the global search LYRICS group). Reproduction: Catalog → search 'PINK SIDES' → click edit (data-cact="edit") → inspect [data-testid="lyrics-textarea"] value — expected to contain the stored lines; actual: empty string. Mitigation: when state.editing is set from a catalog block, call setLyrics(parseLyricsFor(editing.title)) before paintLyr(), and set L.mode = L.lines.length ? 'sync' : 'write' so the Sync tab auto-opens as the review spec requires.
